baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 7-9, تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًا, especially the relational مَعِىَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The capacity root supplies enablement and mutual compliance, while the patience root supplies restraint of the self. With مَعِىَ, the verse tests whether reactive judgment can remain constrained inside a companion-led relation.

activation_trace.role: Ability and enablement make the negated verb a capacity test rather than a forecast of mere annoyance.
Mutual agreement and following make the tested capacity specifically relational with مَعِىَ.
Holding the self back from distress supplies the restraint required within that relation.

changed_reading.before: The addressee will not manage ordinary patience with the speaker.
changed_reading.after: The addressee cannot keep his own evaluative reaction restrained while consenting to remain under this companion's lead.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled saying construction قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل at words 1 and 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The present utterance reintroduces an earlier utterance, so speech becomes evidence: the warning is not merely repeated but made to point to its own fulfillment.

activation_trace.role: Voiced saying supplies both the current rebuke and the embedded prior warning.
A thing's saying as its indication turns the repeated warning into a sign of demonstrated incapacity.

changed_reading.before: The speaker reminds the addressee of something already said.
changed_reading.after: The reminder treats the addressee's latest reaction as evidence that the earlier capacity diagnosis has now verified itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The traveler has already sustained long movement, fatigue, and retracing, then asks to follow a teacher. Context therefore narrows the negated capacity in 18:75 from endurance in general to disciplined endurance of opaque guidance.

activation_trace.role: Focus patience names the self-restraint whose domain the journey contrast narrows.
Constancy under negation supplies the traveler's declared refusal to cease moving.
An extended epoch stretches the declared horizon of physical persistence.
Exhausting toil shows that bodily hardship has already been borne.
Following a trace supplies deliberate retracing after the missed sign.
Following behind makes the new test one of apprenticeship rather than travel stamina.

structural_cues: 18:60 declares open-ended persistence; 18:62 records fatigue; 18:64 retraces the route; 18:66 requests to follow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies demonstrated travel endurance and a requested following relation; I infer a contrast between physical persistence and epistemic-relational restraint. A live alternative is that both remain instances of one general endurance faculty under different loads.

changed_reading.before: You lack sufficient endurance to stay with me.
changed_reading.after: Your proven stamina is not the issue; what fails is restraint when the guide's actions remain unintelligible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding exchange defines an information-release protocol: incomplete encompassing knowledge makes patience difficult, and the follower must not ask until the guide himself brings the matter into speech. The focus rebuke enforces failed timing, not silence as an end in itself.

activation_trace.role: Relational compliance anchors the context's disclosure rule in the focus capacity test.
Complete cognitive encompassing names what the follower does not yet possess.
Knowledge of the inner matter identifies the missing explanatory layer.
Departure from obedience makes the follower's promise explicitly procedural.
Questioning is the action suspended by the agreed rule.
The guide's own bringing-forth supplies the authorized moment of disclosure.
Mention running on the tongue makes that disclosure an initiated verbal account.

structural_cues: 18:68 links patience to absent encompassing knowledge; 18:70 places questioning after guide-initiated mention.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies missing inner knowledge, a ban on premature questions, and guide-initiated mention; I infer that the causal arrow runs from delayed disclosure to the need for patience. The alternative is a simpler obedience test with explanation timing only incidental.

changed_reading.before: Patience means tolerating another person's difficult conduct.
changed_reading.after: Patience means preserving the agreed order of action first and guide-initiated explanation later, despite the pressure to question now.

context_deltas.mechanism: The capacity formula moves from forecast to first reminder to the focus's more pointed reminder, after which the follower sets one final condition and companionship ends at the next breach. The focus ayah is therefore a threshold-setting checkpoint in a finite sequence.

activation_trace.role: The focus reminder makes prior speech indicate an accumulating record of fulfillment.
The initial voiced forecast establishes the capacity claim before any breach.
The first embedded reminder begins converting forecast into accountability.
Repeated negated ability keeps capacity, rather than isolated misconduct, under review.
Repeated self-restraint marks the same tested variable across checkpoints.
Companionship and continued attachment become the stake of the next failure.
Reaching an endpoint turns accumulated breaches into a sufficient excuse for termination.
Separation realizes the boundary anticipated immediately after the focus rebuke.

structural_cues: The formula appears at 18:67, 18:72, 18:75, 18:78, and 18:82; 18:75 uniquely inserts لَكَ into the repeated rebuke before 18:76's final condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrence, direct address, a self-imposed last chance, and eventual separation; I infer an escalating checkpoint structure. The alternative is emphatic repetition without a formal strike sequence.

changed_reading.before: This is another reminder of the same warning.
changed_reading.after: This is the penultimate checkpoint that converts a prediction into a bounded companionship contract approaching termination.

context_deltas.mechanism: After separation, a delivered account returns each act to its consequence: a hidden coercive threat, a replacement, and preserved property released at maturity. Patience becomes suspension of final judgment until an act's temporal outcome can be disclosed.

activation_trace.role: Holding the self back anchors the later outcome horizon in the focus word.
A delivered report supplies the postponed explanatory account.
Return to consequence or final issue makes outcome, not first appearance, the interpretive horizon.
Something screened from appearance supplies the concealed coercive threat behind the damaged vessel.
Violent unjust taking supplies the later danger against which the local damage operates.
One thing standing in place of another supplies the second act's future-facing result.
Arrival at maturity fixes a delayed time at which the preserved benefit becomes accessible.
Bringing a hidden thing out supplies the final movement from concealment to intelligibility.
The closing return to consequence explicitly reconnects explanation with the repeated patience formula.

structural_cues: 18:78 announces explanation only at separation; 18:79-82 provide three causal accounts; 18:82 closes with consequence and the capacity-patience formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit causes and later beneficiaries or avoided harms; I infer that patience holds judgment open until those consequences are available. The live alternative is patience as obedience regardless of whether consequences are ever learned.

changed_reading.before: The addressee cannot calmly endure disturbing acts.
changed_reading.after: The addressee cannot defer a final reading of those acts across the interval between visible action and disclosed consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first incident pairs a visible breach and feared drowning with a later coercive seizure of every intact vessel. A bounded defect can preserve the vessel as a whole, making focus patience the capacity to tolerate local impairment before its protective function is visible.

activation_trace.role: Focus restraint is recast as withholding total condemnation of a visible local injury.
A hole or rupture supplies the bounded material damage that provokes the objection.
Drowning supplies the immediate catastrophic outcome projected from that damage.
The vessel cutting the water identifies the working whole that the defect leaves in its owners' hands.
Royal power supplies the asymmetrical agent capable of systematic confiscation.
Taking possession supplies the total loss avoided by making the vessel undesirable.
Unjust coercive seizure gives the local defect its protective target.

structural_cues: 18:79's branchless ع ي ب occurrence at word 10 explicitly identifies the intended local defect.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies damage, a feared sinking, intended defect, and forced taking of every vessel; I infer that limited impairment blocks total confiscation. The alternative is that the defect merely substitutes one material risk for another rather than cleanly preserving the whole.

changed_reading.before: Patience would mean tolerating apparently destructive behavior.
changed_reading.after: Patience can mean not equating a local defect with total ruin before the larger predatory system becomes visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus rebuke follows the sharpest collision between present evidence and later account: a living, visibly pure person is killed, while the explanation invokes feared future overwhelming transgression and a better replacement. The tested patience becomes the impossible demand to suspend immediate moral protest under radically asymmetric temporal knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Focus restraint attaches the contextual collision back to the demanded holding-back of protest.
Taking life supplies the irreversible act that makes restraint morally extreme.
The living self keeps the objection attached to an actual life rather than an abstract offense.
Purity and soundness supply the present-visible moral evidence behind the protest.
A severe strange act registers the follower's immediate evaluative horizon.
Fear with gravity supplies the explanation's anticipatory orientation.
Overwhelming and overpowering supplies the projected pressure on the parents.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies one projected future burden.
The packet's second mapped root independently preserves the same limit-crossing image rather than collapsing the split mapping.
Veiling the truth supplies the other projected future burden.
Replacement supplies the asserted future reordering after the loss.
Nurturing, repair, and completion frame that replacement as developmental rather than merely substitutive.
Tender mercy names the relational quality claimed for the replacement.

structural_cues: 18:75 immediately follows the second objection; 18:80-81 disclose the feared future and replacement only after separation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present purity, killing, future fear, projected transgression, and replacement; I infer that the rebuke exposes an unbridgeable temporal-evidence asymmetry. A materially live alternative is that 18:75 addresses only breach of the agreed rule, not the moral correctness of protesting; this mechanism must not be generalized beyond the sealed narrative.

changed_reading.before: The rebuke faults insufficient calm after a shocking act.
changed_reading.after: The rebuke marks the limit at which present moral evidence makes deferred judgment practically impossible for a follower denied the future rationale.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus warning, the final action stabilizes a collapsing wall without immediate payment; the later account links it to orphaned owners, hidden property, and future maturity. Patience with the guide includes tolerating nontransactional labor whose beneficiary and release time are concealed.

activation_trace.role: Relational compliance anchors the final action's challenge in the focus phrase مَعِىَ.
Undoing a firmly built structure supplies the wall's imminent collapse through the packet's mapped root.
Straightening and restoring equilibrium supplies the guide's preserving repair.
Payment for work supplies the immediate transactional reading proposed by the follower.
Children cut off from their protector supply the vulnerable absent beneficiaries.
Stored protected wealth supplies what the repaired wall keeps concealed.
Reaching a goal fixes maturity as the preservation horizon.
Attaining full strength specifies when the owners can receive the protected property.
Bringing the hidden property out supplies the delayed release.
Merciful tenderness gives the unrewarded repair its beneficiary-oriented motive.

structural_cues: 18:77 contrasts refused hospitality, unpaid repair, and a proposed wage; 18:82 relocates value to preservation for future owners.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unpaid stabilization, absent vulnerable owners, concealed wealth, and maturity; I infer that present nonreciprocity enables future preservation. The alternative is that the wage remark is simply the third prohibited question, with transactional reasoning secondary.

changed_reading.before: Patience means refraining from criticizing an unrewarded choice.
changed_reading.after: Patience means allowing care to bypass immediate reciprocity because its real beneficiary and proper release time may both be hidden.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's split mapping from ق و ل to ق ل ل and is therefore branch-distant, but the carrying image remains anchored by the focus's negated capacity and مَعِىَ and is reinforced by later companionship language. Render only as a material analogy for the relation, never as the lexical sense of أَقُل.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The construction أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكَ ... مَعِىَ combines the split ق ل ل inventory with capacity and being-with.

activation_trace.role: Carrying a load and rising under it supplies a material image for bearing the apprenticeship's relational weight.
Guarantee and continued attendance turn patience into sustained responsibility beside another.
Companionship and close attendance confirm that remaining together is the load at stake.

changed_reading.before: The warning concerns an inner quantity of patience.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the warning tests whether the follower can carry the weight of remaining answerable within this companionship.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The stacked-cloud branch is materially remote from ordinary patience, but it is anchored in focus صَبْرًا and gains a visible sequence from three unresolved incidents followed by one delayed account. Downstream prose should mark this as a packet-induced image of accumulation, not etymology or a final interpretation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus صَبْرًا at word 9 viewed through its packet branch of one layer held over another.

activation_trace.role: Cloud layers held one above another supply the exploratory image of unresolved scenes accumulating without discharge.
The vessel rupture supplies the first unresolved layer.
The severe strange killing supplies a heavier second layer.
The wall nearing structural undoing supplies the third layer before explanation.
Return to consequence releases the accumulated layers into a retrospective account.

changed_reading.before: Each event demands a separate burst of patience.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, patience is the capacity to let several opaque scenes accumulate without forcing premature discharge into explanation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The rising-extension branch comes from the packet's split mapping of ط و ع to س ط ع, and the observed surface shortening may be ordinary morphology rather than designed enactment. It remains anchored in the repeated capacity verb and exact packet forms; qualify it as a formal-spatial echo, not semantic proof.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus تَسْتَطِيعَ at word 7 in the repeated sequence تَسْتَطِيعَ / تَسْتَطِع / تَسْطِع.

activation_trace.role: Extension and rising supply a spatial image for the still-long distance between action and explanation at the focus.
The shorter capacity form appears when explanation is first announced and the interpretive distance begins to close.
The shortest packet form appears after the hidden mechanisms have been brought fully into view.

changed_reading.before: The repeated verb states the same binary incapacity each time.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the verb's surface contracts as the explanatory interval contracts, giving incapacity a diminishing spatial profile.

strongest_changes: Context separates physical stamina from the epistemic-relational restraint demanded by مَعِىَ.
The exchange defines patience as waiting for guide-initiated disclosure rather than suppressing questions absolutely.
Repetition turns 18:75 into an escalating checkpoint whose next breach terminates companionship.
The final explanations recast patience as holding judgment open until consequences and hidden beneficiaries become visible.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah is both self-verifying speech and a hinge: it follows the most morally resistant incident, adds pointed direct address, and immediately produces the final boundary of companionship. Split-root branches also exposed contained material images of carrying, stacking, and shrinking explanatory distance.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the repeated warnings constitute a formal staged contract or only emphatic narrative recurrence.
Whether outcome-oriented patience is primary or remains subordinate to obedience independent of explanation.
The killing-and-replacement mechanism is sealed-narrative evidence only and cannot safely support a general moral rule.
The split-root carrying, stacking, and form-contraction readings are exploratory analogies rather than lexical claims.
